name: message-pattern
description: A MessageFormat 2 pattern in Telo's profile: literal text, variable placeholders {$name} — a name starts with a letter or _, continues with letters, digits or _, and is not a CEL reserved word — and the escapes \{, \} and \\. Whitespace and bidi marks MF2 allows inside the braces are accepted. Literals, functions, options, attributes and markup in braces are outside the profile.
